answer: At dawn a claimant climbs to a canyon rim and presses a fresh yarrow sprig into a clay tablet, photographed against the horizon with a timestamp and a witness beside the canyon log. Two canyon keepers verify the photograph against the yarrow registry and the horizon log within five days. A copied photograph, a wrong canyon, or a missing log entry voids the season, burns a 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for a year. One honest claimant spends 60 credits; a thousand fakes would need a thousand canyon climbs and a thousand yarrow pressings.
